exposure: maternal feeling of breast emptying after feeding
outcome: newborn weight loss at 72 hours and day 10
percentage of newborns with 5% weight loss
percentage of newborns with 10% weight loss
cohort: 320 term newborns with birth weight >2500g admitted to a tertiary center in urban Bangalore, India
finding: Maternal transfer to post-op ward, sore/cracked/flat nipple, and inadequate breastfeeding were significantly associated with newborn weight loss.
mod_finding: Babies born via cesarean section (54.68%) were more likely to experience significant weight loss than those born vaginally (43.43%), but significance was not explicitly mentioned in the results.  Mothers shifted to a post-op ward were more likely to have babies with both 5% and 10% weight loss (p<0.0001).
